description: Wait for a browser login started by `auth login-start` or `workspace create` until the person approves or denies it, or it expires (10 minutes after it started). Once approved, saves the API key as a workspace, saves the signing key, makes it active, and returns the workspace (never the key). Denied and expired logins are returned as such and forgotten. If this call is cut off, call it again to keep waiting.

requestId.description: Login to check. Defaults to the most recent pending login.

name: auth_login-status
